extras: Desktop only, because it uses Node's zlib, which Obsidian mobile doesn't have. One-off engine download required for OCR.
motivation: The author built it to provide a conversion solution that requires nothing to install and avoids the dependency on Python and pip, unlike other plugins.
problem: Existing conversion tools often lose structural integrity, require external dependencies like Python, or rely on cloud services, leading to loss of data fidelity.
summary: Converts various document formats (PDF, Office, images) into structured Markdown notes, preserving formatting and extracting data into properties.
